BiblicalUsage: Nymphon is the bridal chamber, the room where the bridegroom's friends gather. Jesus speaks in Matthew 9:15 and Mark 2:19 of the children of the bridechamber, who cannot mourn or fast while the bridegroom is with them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the bridal chamber is where joy belongs, and the friends of the Bridegroom fast only when He is gone.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
